Places.Name: the Old Throne
Places.Lore: Merewin the Builder's throne of black stone, worn smooth on the left arm.

Places.Name: the Hearth
Places.Lore: The great fire below the throne hill, where the Charter was sworn. It has never gone out.

Places.Name: the Crown Market
Places.Lore: Stalls rebuilt every season on the Builders' foundations. Never haggle on the first stone.

Places.Name: the Tollbridge
Places.Lore: Fallen and rebuilt a dozen times. Every monarch claims the toll; every trader swears they paid it.

Places.Name: the Listing Field
Places.Lore: Where champions fight for Ashgrove's wreath of oak, and the winner stands on the Stone.

Places.Name: the Crown Wold
Places.Lore: The old forest of the Builders' huntsmen. The quarry may run, but may not hide.

Places.Name: Varrow's Stair
Places.Lore: A stone keep on the hill road, its steps worn by nine generations of masons.

Places.Name: Ashgrove Vale
Places.Lore: Orchard-holds of the eastern vale. The oldest trees are scarred black at the root.

Places.Name: Corvane's Reach
Places.Lore: A tower over the river crossing and the realm's oldest rookery.

Places.Name: Drowned Dunmere
Places.Lore: A flooded town whose bell is said to ring at low tide before the throne changes hands.

Places.Name: the Ember Pass
Places.Lore: Forge-camps of the southern pass, and the old ransom-pits Halloran still keeps swept.

Places.Name: Merrin's Ford
Places.Lore: A river market at a shallow ford. Nobody quite trusts it, and everybody shops there.
